g.text: Fig G1 · One breath, three layers

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family:Inter, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; fill: #152126

g.text: Peak = resistance + stretch + PEEP. Stop the flow (inspiratory hold) and the resistance layer vanishes: what remains is the plateau.

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family:Inter, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; fill: #152126

g.text: Plateau − PEEP is the stretch of the lung and chest = driving pressure.
